name: Ink Trail
source:
After collecting enough ink to leave the fume-infested cave, Mitai finds himself framed for a crime he never committed. After prodding from his business parter Kadava, he decides to sneak into the one place people never return for answers. The office.

But is the upstanding Mitai willing to go against his morals to climb the cutt-throat ranks of the franchisees? 

[From [url=https://seedhee.itch.io/ink-trail]Itch.io[/url]]
